title: Add Tree Chart Mark

complexity.rationale: The tidy-tree layout itself is a native Vega transform pipeline (`stratify` + `tree`), not custom geometry to design. But click/Enter collapse-expand of subtrees requires a new signal tracking a set of collapsed node ids and a data-level filter keyed off that set, and ancestor-chain hover highlighting requires walking each node's parent chain to determine highlight membership — both are genuinely new interaction logic with no existing analog in this codebase, though each is a well-understood, single-purpose piece once designed.

summary: An id/parent/label hierarchy mark rendering a tidy tree layout (Vega's `stratify` + `tree` transforms), with click/Enter collapse-expand of subtrees and ancestor-chain hover highlighting.
requirements: Accepts `id`, `parent` (required) and an optional `label` channel; auto-repairs flat data with missing parents/root by synthesizing them before stratification, so malformed hierarchies don't hard-fail
Renders a tidy tree layout via Vega's `stratify` + `tree` transforms — node symbols plus link paths between parent/child
Clicking or pressing Enter on a node collapses or expands its subtree (hides/shows descendant nodes and links)
Hovering a node highlights its full ancestor chain back to the root, not just the hovered node itself

edgeCases.case: Data with no explicit root (all rows have a non-null parent)
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Auto-repair synthesizes a root node so `stratify` doesn't fail, per the auto-repair requirement.

edgeCases.case: Data with multiple disconnected root candidates
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Auto-repair synthesizes a single synthetic root parenting all otherwise-orphaned nodes, so the layout renders one tree rather than throwing on multiple roots.
Renders one node with no links; collapse/expand is a no-op since there's nothing to collapse.
Hides the entire tree except the root itself, which remains visible and expandable.
Tidy tree layout scales node spacing to depth automatically via the Vega `tree` transform; no special-case handling needed beyond what the transform already provides.
Node and link colors resolve through the existing colorScheme-aware color scale.
S1-only for this spec; no S2 port until the mark stabilizes out of rc status.
Collapse/expand must be keyboard-reachable (Enter key), not click-only, per the stated requirement.

crossCutting.notes: touchesControlledHighlight: ancestor-chain highlighting on hover is a new highlight-membership computation (walking the parent chain), not a reuse of CONTROLLED_HIGHLIGHTED_TABLE/SERIES, though it should follow the same opacity-encode convention those use. touchesTooltipOrPopover: node hover/click can show a ChartTooltip/ChartPopover with label/id, reusing existing interactive-mark plumbing. requiresNewSignalOrScale: true — a `collapsedNodes` signal (set/cleared by click/Enter) driving a visibility filter transform, plus a `hoveredNode` signal driving ancestor-chain computation. requiresS1S2Parity: false because this ships as a new s1-only rc-status mark, matching the Donut/BigNumber precedent; revisit once promoted out of rc.

openQuestions: Should collapsedNodes be exposed as a controlled prop (consumer-driven initial collapse state) in addition to click/Enter, or purely internal signal state for v1?
What visual treatment distinguishes an ancestor-chain highlight from a regular hover — dimmed non-ancestors, bolded links, or both?
